description: The configuration that turns a workflow state or status label into semantic flags. State names live here, as data. No business logic anywhere compares a state string; it reads the flags this table sets. That is what makes a state rename configuration rather than a rebuild.

fields.description: The field carrying the state or status label — workflow_state, or a status field.
fields.label: State Field

fields.description: Whether the record is still awaiting action in this state.
fields.label: Is Open

fields.description: Used by the import pipeline; a staged row may be committed from this state.
fields.label: Is Committable

fields.description: Whether a record in this state must carry a written statement — an attestation exception or a declination.
fields.label: Requires Statement

fields.description: For a record whose business-facing phase follows its workflow state (a governing document once its lifecycle runs on workflow_state): the phase this state belongs to, one of the phase field's fixed options. Adding a state is then a Workflow row plus this row, with no change to the phase field.
fields.label: Phase

fields.description: Set automatically from the decision. Ticked only for a decision that gives consent, so an abstention does not count as an approval.
fields.label: Is Affirmative

name: Workflow State Flag
